name: duopore-public-category-reference-mapping
description: Match supplier category names to the category names in your own list.

interface.longDescription: Match supplier category names to the category names in your own list. Provide the old category names and your mapping rules. See which names match and which still need a rule. Choose exact matching or ignore spaces and letter case. The app uses your rules; it does not look up marketplace categories or guess where a product belongs.
defaultPrompt: Match these supplier categories to my own category list.
Which product categories still need a mapping rule?
